title: Settings › Pricing has Tiers, Matrices and Fixed Rules tabs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a fixed sell price set on an inventory part for this test, so the Fixed Rules tab has a row.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the Fixed Rules tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page shows three tabs: Tiers, Matrices and Fixed Rules.
  • Today's "Pricing Matrices" tab is gone (compare the Today picture).
  • The Tiers tab is open.

Step 2:

  • The Fixed Rules tab lists the fixed sell price set for this test.
  • It lists fixed rules alone: no matrix and no tier shows on it.
